{{Top|leg}}
'''Binny''' was an individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Binny and a friend wished to settle a bet regarding creatures they called [[mushwump]]s.<ref name="SWG:SaBB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Settle a Bar Bet}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Binny was first mentioned in a [[W:c:swg:Mission Terminal|mission terminal]] quest in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG:SaBB" />
